digest.component_or_area: binding store persistence and selective-publication seam
propositions: Repository delegation must not blur the boundary between local multi-file persistence and selective ticket-branch publication.
The existing five-file allowlist and unchanged-pass no-commit behavior must be preserved and regression-tested through the delegation facade.
Repository checkpoints and GET rotation must not independently trigger publication; publication remains owned by reconcile_helpers.py.

ADR 0099 must document ownership scope (subsystem-level with named exemptions), ordered partial-state rules, persistence-vs-publication split, and explicit rejections of journal/format-migration/deep-copy approaches.
Binding-store tests must pass unchanged when run through the delegating facade after removal of superseded facade persistence branches.
